# Nick Milo

Nick Milo is the creator of [[Linking Your Thinking (LYT)]], the author of the Ideaverse Lite starter kit (see [[Ideaverse Lite (kit)]]) and teacher of the LYT Workshop. He publishes at linkingyourthinking.com. The kit says he has worked as a football coach, civil engineer, entrepreneur and filmmaker (including television editing), experience he credits for his habit of reapplying patterns across fields.

## Contributions in this ingest
- [[Maps of Content]], the [[Home Note]], [[Fluid Frameworks (LYT)]] and [[Higher-Order Notes]]
- The [[ACE Folder Framework (LYT)]] and [[STIR]]
- Efforts as an alternative to projects: [[Efforts vs Projects]]
- Promotion of [[Note-Making]] and [[Evergreen Notes (LYT)]]
- The term [[Ideaverse]]

## Influences he cites
Andy Matuschak (evergreen notes), Niklas Luhmann (atomic notes, hub notes), Steen Comer (fluid taxonomies), Christian of zettelkasten.de (arguments against categories), Richard Saul Wurman ([[Information Anxiety (book)]]), and Karen Hume (collaboration on the ACE intention lens).
